```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggExtra)
library(plyr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggExtra)
library(psych)
library(psycho)
library(effsize)
library(lsr)
library(lmerTest)


setwd("/Users/xuanzhao/Dropbox/Zhao Epley Happy to Help/OSF documents/Study 4 Friend v. Stranger")
data_folder <- "/Users/xuanzhao/Dropbox/Zhao Epley Happy to Help/OSF documents/Study 4 Friend v. Stranger/"
file <- "Study 4 data.csv"

hhh4_data <- read_csv(paste0(data_folder,file))
hhh4_data$Pair_ID <- as.factor(hhh4_data$Pair_ID) 

lower_ci <- function(mean, se, n, conf_level = 0.95){
  lower_ci <- mean - qt(1 - ((1 - conf_level) / 2), n - 1) * se
}

hhh4_data <- hhh4_data%>%
  mutate(Relationship = factor(Relationship, levels = c("Stranger", "Friend")) )

hhh4_stranger <- hhh4_data %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Stranger")
hhh4_friend <- hhh4_data %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Friend")

```

# Miscalibration

## Willing to help & Interested in helping?

Correlation between "willing to help" and "interested in helping":

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_willing <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, willing_A, willing_B, Relationship) %>%
  gather(Perspective, willing, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("willing_A", "willing_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_interest <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, interested_A, interested_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, interest, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("interested_A", "interested_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_willingness <- hhh4_willing
hhh4_willingness$interest <- hhh4_interest$interest
hhh4_willingness$willingness <- (hhh4_willingness$willing + hhh4_willingness$interest)/2

cor.test(hhh4_willingness$willing, hhh4_willingness$interest)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

ggbarplot(hhh4_willingness, x = "Perspective", y = "willingness", add = "mean_se", 
          color = "black", fill = "Perspective", alpha = 0.75, 
          facet.by = "Relationship", 
          palette = c("#767676","#181818"), 
          position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Willingness to help") + 
  rremove("x.text") + 
  font("xlab", size = 12) +
  font("x.text", size = 12) +
  font("ylab", size = 12) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10))+
  font("legend.title", size = 12) +
  font("legend.text", size = 12) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,2))

# ggsave("hhh4_willingness.pdf", plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)

anova_result <- summary(aov(willingness ~ Relationship * Perspective + Error(Pair_ID/Perspective), data = hhh4_willingness))
print(anova_result)

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Relationship)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Relationship)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])

ddply(hhh4_willingness, c("Perspective", "Relationship"), summarise,
               N    = length(willingness),
               mean = mean(willingness, na.rm = TRUE),
               sd   = sd(willingness, na.rm = TRUE),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N), 
               ci = mean - lower_ci(mean, se, N))

```

Expected willingness ~ relationship closeness?

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_friend$willingnessA <- (hhh4_friend$willing_A + hhh4_friend$willing_B)/2
cor.test(hhh4_friend$willingnessA, hhh4_friend$relationship_close)

```

Simple effects:

**Friend:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_willing_friend <- hhh4_willingness %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Friend")
t.test(willingness ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_willing_friend, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(willingness ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_willing_friend)

```

**Stranger:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_willing_stranger <- hhh4_willingness %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Stranger")
t.test(willingness ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_willing_stranger, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(willingness ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_willing_stranger)

```

## Discomfort rejecting request

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_difficult <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, difficult_A, difficult_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, difficult, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("difficult_A", "difficult_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_awkward <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, awkward_A, awkward_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, awkward, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("awkward_A", "awkward_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_embarrased <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, embarrased_A, embarrased_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, embarrased, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("embarrased_A", "embarrased_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 


hhh4_difficult$awkward <-hhh4_awkward$awkward
hhh4_difficult$embarrased <- hhh4_embarrased$embarrased

disc_scale <- hhh4_difficult %>%
  dplyr::select(difficult:embarrased)

psych::alpha(disc_scale, check.keys = TRUE)

hhh4_difficult$discomfort <- (hhh4_difficult$difficult + hhh4_difficult$awkward + hhh4_difficult$embarrased)/3

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

ggbarplot(hhh4_difficult, x = "Perspective", y = "discomfort", add = "mean_se",
      color = "Perspective", fill = "Perspective", facet.by = "Relationship", 
      alpha = 0.8, palette = c("#767676","#800D00"),
      position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
      # stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", paired = TRUE, aes(label = paste0("p =", ..p.format..)),label.x = 1.4) +
    ylab("Discomfort of rejecting compliance") + 
     coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10)) +
  theme(rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent"))

anova_result <- summary(aov(discomfort ~ Relationship * Perspective + Error(Pair_ID/Perspective), data = hhh4_difficult))
print(anova_result)

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Relationship)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Relationship)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])


ddply(hhh4_difficult, c("Perspective", "Relationship"), summarise,
               N    = length(discomfort),
               mean = mean(discomfort),
               sd   = sd(discomfort),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N), 
               ci = mean - lower_ci(mean, se, N))

```

Simple effects:

**Friend:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_difficult_friend <- hhh4_difficult %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Friend")
t.test(discomfort ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_difficult_friend, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(discomfort ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_difficult_friend)

```

**Stranger:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_difficult_stranger <- hhh4_difficult %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Stranger")
t.test(discomfort ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_difficult_stranger, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(discomfort ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_difficult_stranger)

```


## Motivation Attribution

### Prosocial motivation 

* This person wants to help me get my picture taken.
* This person wants to do something nice for me.

*[-3: Strongly disagree; 3: Strongly agree]*

Correlation between two items:

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

# Combining both parties into a long format
hhh4_pro1 <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, motivation_A_1, motivation_B_1) %>%
  gather(Perspective, pro1, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("motivation_A_1", "motivation_B_1"), labels = c("Predicted", "Actual"))) 

hhh4_pro2 <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, motivation_A_2, motivation_B_2) %>%
  gather(Perspective, pro2, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("motivation_A_2", "motivation_B_2"), labels = c("Predicted", "Actual"))) 

hhh4_pro1$pro2 <-hhh4_pro2$pro2

cor.test(hhh4_pro1$pro1, hhh4_pro1$pro2)

```

Repeated ANOVA:

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

## So I collapsed two prosocial motivation measures here for ANOVA

hhh4_pro1$pro <- (hhh4_pro1$pro1 + hhh4_pro1$pro2)/2

anova_result <- summary(aov(pro ~ Relationship * Perspective + Error(Pair_ID/Perspective), data = hhh4_pro1))
print(anova_result)

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Relationship)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Relationship)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])


## Graphing

ggbarplot(hhh4_pro1, x = "Perspective", y = "pro", add = "mean_se", 
          color = "black", fill = "Perspective", alpha = 0.75, 
          facet.by = "Relationship", 
          palette = c("#767676","#181818"), 
          position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Prosocial Motivation") + 
  rremove("x.text") + 
  font("xlab", size = 12) +
  font("x.text", size = 12) +
  font("ylab", size = 12) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3,3))+
  font("legend.title", size = 12) +
  font("legend.text", size = 12) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-3,3,1))

# ggsave("hhh4_prosocial.pdf", plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", width = 4.5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)

ddply(hhh4_pro1, c("Perspective", "Relationship"), summarise,
               N    = length(pro),
               mean = mean(pro),
               sd   = sd(pro),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N), 
               ci = mean - lower_ci(mean, se, N))

```

Simple effects:

**Friend:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_pro1_friend <- hhh4_pro1 %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Friend")
t.test(pro ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_pro1_friend, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(pro ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_pro1_friend)

```

**Stranger:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_pro1_stranger <- hhh4_pro1 %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Stranger")
t.test(pro ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_pro1_stranger, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(pro ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_pro1_stranger)

```


### Compliance motivation 

* This person wants to avoid saying “no” to my request.
* This person is forced to take a picture for me because I asked him/her to.

*[-3: Strongly disagree; 3: Strongly agree]*

Correlation between two items:

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_com1 <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, motivation_A_3, motivation_B_3) %>%
  gather(Perspective, com1, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("motivation_A_3", "motivation_B_3"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_com2 <- hhh4_data %>%

```

## Experience of helping

### Positive Mood

Correlationship between feeling positive (-5 to 5) and pleasant (0 to 10):

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_positive <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, positive_pre_A, pos_other_post_A, positive_post_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, positive, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("positive_pre_A", "pos_other_post_A", "positive_post_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Requester-Post", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_pleasant <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, pleased_pre_A, pleased_other_post_A, pleased_post_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, pleasant, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("pleased_pre_A", "pleased_other_post_A", "pleased_post_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Requester-Post", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_positive$pleasant <-hhh4_pleasant$pleasant

cor.test(hhh4_positive$positive, hhh4_positive$pleasant)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

## So I collapsed two prosocial motivation measures here for ANOVA
hhh4_positive$posmood <- (hhh4_positive$positive + 5 + hhh4_positive$pleasant)/2

anova_result <- summary(aov(posmood ~ Relationship * Perspective + Error(Pair_ID/Perspective), data = hhh4_positive))
print(anova_result)

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Relationship)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Relationship)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])


ggbarplot(hhh4_positive, x = "Perspective", y = "posmood", add = "mean_se",
      color = "Perspective", fill = "Perspective", facet.by = "Relationship", 
      alpha = 0.8, palette = "uchicago", 
      position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
      ylab("Positive Mood") + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(5, 10)) 

hhh4_positive_comparison <- hhh4_positive %>%
  filter(Perspective != 'Requester-Post')

ggbarplot(hhh4_positive_comparison, x = "Perspective", y = "posmood", add = "mean_se", 
          color = "black", fill = "Perspective", alpha = 0.75, 
          facet.by = "Relationship", 
          palette = c("#767676","#181818"), 
          position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Positive Mood") + 
  rremove("x.text") + 
  font("xlab", size = 12) +
  font("x.text", size = 12) +
  font("ylab", size = 12) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10))+
  font("legend.title", size = 12) +
  font("legend.text", size = 12) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,2))

# ggsave("hhh4_posmood.pdf", plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", width = 4.5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)

ddply(hhh4_positive, c("Perspective", "Relationship"), summarise,
               N    = length(posmood),
               mean = mean(posmood),
               sd   = sd(posmood),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N), 
               ci = mean - lower_ci(mean, se, N))

```


Simple effects:

**Friend:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_positive_comparison <- droplevels(hhh4_positive_comparison)

hhh4_positive_friend <- hhh4_positive_comparison %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Friend")
t.test(posmood ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_positive_friend, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(posmood ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_positive_friend)

```

**Stranger:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_positive_stranger <- hhh4_positive_comparison %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Stranger")
t.test(posmood ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_positive_stranger, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(posmood ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_positive_stranger)

```

### Inconvenience Perception

Correlation between feeling annoyed and perceiving inconvenience (0 to 10):

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_incon <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, inconvenient_pre_A, inconvenient_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, inc, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("inconvenient_pre_A", "inconvenient_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_annoy <- hhh4_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Relationship, annoyed_pre_A, annoyed_B) %>%

  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("annoyed_pre_A", "annoyed_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 

hhh4_incon$annoy <-hhh4_annoy$annoy

cor.test(hhh4_incon$inc, hhh4_incon$annoy)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

## So I collapsed two incon perception measures here for ANOVA

print(anova_result)

between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Relationship)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])

ggbarplot(hhh4_incon, x = "Perspective", y = "inc_per", add = "mean_se", 
          color = "black", fill = "Perspective", alpha = 0.75,

  font("ylab", size = 12) +

               sd   = sd(inc_per),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N), 
               ci = mean - lower_ci(mean, se, N))
```

Simple effects:

**Friend:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_incon_friend <- hhh4_incon %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Friend")
t.test(inc_per ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_incon_friend, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(inc_per ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_incon_friend)

```

**Stranger:**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_incon_stranger <- hhh4_incon %>%
  filter(Relationship == "Stranger")
t.test(inc_per ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_incon_stranger, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)
effsize::cohen.d(inc_per ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh4_incon_stranger)

```

# Exploratory analysis

### Request size

* How “big” of a request did this appear to be from your perspective?

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_size <- hhh4_data %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Relationship, request_size_A, request_size_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, size, -Pair_ID, -Relationship) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("request_size_A", "request_size_B"), labels = c("Requester", "Helper"))) 


anova_result <- summary(aov(size ~ Relationship * Perspective + Error(Pair_ID/Perspective), data = hhh4_size))
print(anova_result)

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Relationship)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Relationship)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])

# effsize::cohen.d(inc_per_three ~ Perspective, data = hhh4_incon)


ggbarplot(hhh4_size, x = "Perspective", y = "size", add = "mean_se",
      color = "Perspective", fill = "Perspective", facet.by = "Relationship", 
      alpha = 0.7, palette = "lancet", 
      position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
      ylab("Request size") + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", paired = TRUE, aes(label = paste0("p =", ..p.format..)),label.x = 1.4)


ddply(hhh4_size, c("Perspective", "Relationship"), summarise,
               N    = length(size),
               mean = mean(size),
               sd   = sd(size),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N))

```

## Help-seeking anxiety

### Friend vs. Stranger

Did people feel more anxious/uncomfortable when requesting help from a stranger than a friend?

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh4_data$anxiety <- (hhh4_data$uncomfortable_A + hhh4_data$anxious_A)/2

hhh4_data <- hhh4_data %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Relationship, levels = c("Friend", "Stranger"), labels = c("Friend", "Stranger")))

anx.aov <- aov(anxiety ~ Relationship, data = hhh4_data)
summary(anx.aov)

etaSquared(anx.aov)

ggbarplot(hhh4_data, x = "Relationship", y = "anxiety", add = "mean_se",
      color = "Relationship", fill = "Relationship",
      alpha = 0.8, palette = "uchicago", 
      position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
      scale_x_discrete(name = "Relationship", limits = c("Friend", "Stranger")) +
      ylab("Requester Anxiety") + 
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5)) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", paired = FALSE, aes(label = paste0("p =", ..p.format..)),label.x = 1.4)


ddply(hhh4_data, c("Relationship"), summarise,
               N    = length(anxiety),
               mean = mean(anxiety),
               sd   = sd(anxiety),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N))

```
